propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic pin per direct child and prerequisite, encoding the target canonical ticket ID and 16-hex material fingerprint in manifest format.

Pin collection must resolve all ticket references uniquely to existing reducer-readable states, discover archived inbound blockers via full store preload, and abort with unsigned INDETERMINATE before any LLM call if any target is unreadable, deleted, or malformed.
Pin ordering is deterministic: sorted lexicographically by role (child before prerequisite), then by canonical ID; duplicate edges within one role collapse to a single pin.

tracker_head_sha() must verify the tickets-tracker is clean post-ensure_fresh using git status --porcelain and ls-files -u, then return the 40-hex HEAD SHA, raising store-read-failure on any git, IO, path, or output error.

manifest_pins() parser must validate every pin line format, reject unknown roles, duplicate role+ID pairs, invalid canonical IDs, and non-16-hex fingerprints, raising ManifestFormatError for any violation.

All three signing paths—ordinary sign_plan_review, progressive drift refresh_attestation, and resign_plan_review—must collect and emit the complete current pin set without user-facing commands or new ticket fields.
